argv:
set -eu
export GOTOOLCHAIN=local
go version
go install golang.org/x/vuln/cmd/govulncheck@v1.1.4
go version -m /go/bin/govulncheck > /out/govulncheck-build.txt
sha256sum /go/bin/govulncheck > /out/govulncheck-sha256.txt
for arch in amd64 arm64; do
  sha256sum /input/gosu-$arch > /out/input-$arch.txt
  go version -m /input/gosu-$arch > /out/modules-$arch.txt
  go tool nm /input/gosu-$arch > /out/nm-$arch.txt 2>/out/nm-$arch.stderr
  set +e
  /go/bin/govulncheck -mode=binary -format=json /input/gosu-$arch > /out/gosu-$arch.govulncheck.json 2>/out/gosu-$arch.govulncheck.stderr
  status=$?
  set -e
  echo "$status" > /out/gosu-$arch.govulncheck.exit
done
